normalization.scale_policy: one shared scale for all eight directions
normalization.method: crisp: BOX area reduction then binary alpha (cutoff 128); integer translation only; no rotation, shear or per-direction scale
normalization.y_authority: semantic support contact (toe_near/toe_far); alpha bottom is fallback only
normalization.derivation: support row 111 leaves a 16px floor margin under the shared 0.2-scale body; ground rail = support row + 1

annotations.provenance: agent visual annotation; confidence recorded per point; occluded points <= 0.4

tolerances.basis: landmark/silhouette noise = 1.0px at 128 (one crisp pixel); structural tolerance = 2.0 x noise; palette tolerance = observed cross-direction spread of the approved reference with a floor

identity_locks: faceless hood: no skin, eyes, nose or mouth ever exposed
hood crown readable under the fixed elevated camera
visor strongest S, partial SE/SW, narrow E/W, minimal NE/NW, absent/near-absent N
graphite/black plate and cloth with restrained antique-gold/amber trim
no direction collapses into a side-on camera

registration.note: X authority is semantic hip_center; bbox center is evidence only

anatomy.foreshortening_note: direction-specific: compare N to N, E to E; never equalize across bearings
